name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 27 times in 9 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 45 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-08-28, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
